component.name: BeerSSH
component.summary: SSH terminal for desktop and Android

description.p: An SSH client with a real terminal emulator, built from one codebase for the desktop and for Android. Sessions live independently of the windows showing them, so tabs, split panes and a phone rotating do not disturb a connection.

ul.li: True-colour terminal emulation with images (sixel, kitty, iTerm2)
Tabs everywhere, split panes where the window is wide enough
Host presets that many hosts share, with per-host overrides
A curated set of terminal fonts and colour schemes
Reconnection with backoff, and keepalive for hostile networks
